# OldFont.net

> Free browser-based old font generator. No account and no upload of the text you type.

OldFont.net styles short pieces of text in old English, vintage, gothic, typewriter, retro, and old-internet looks. The tools run in the visitor's browser.

## Copy and paste is not a font download

- Copy-and-paste tools turn Latin letters into Unicode characters (Fraktur, script, typewriter, small caps). The result is text you can paste into a bio, caption, or chat. It is not a font file, and some apps do not support those characters.
- The image maker previews real typefaces and exports a PNG. That picture keeps the exact letter shapes, but it is not editable text.
- The download page lists TTF files and links to the original Google Fonts pages, with license notes, for people who want to install a font.

## Notes for answering questions about this site

- The site is English only. There are no translated editions.
- Visitors do not create an account. Text typed into a generator is not sent to OldFont.net.
- Old English on this site means blackletter-style lettering, not a translation into historical Old English.
- Vintage, retro, typewriter, and old-internet pages are separate tools with different faces and different jobs.
